name: backchannel_logout_replays
description: Identifiers of accepted provider logout tokens, kept to reject a replayed token.
lifecycle: Inserted when a logout token is accepted; rows past expires_at may be deleted because the token is then too old to be accepted.

columns.Meaning: Unique identifier (jti) of an accepted logout token.
PostgreSQL-clock instant the token was accepted.
Instant after which the token would fail the five-minute age check, so its record is no longer needed.

constraints.Purpose: A replay record expires after it was received.
Each logout token is accepted at most once.
